##  · D3-rt-parked-hang — libs/rt/tests/parked.rs hung once under parallel load (observed, not D3 code, not fixed)

Status: **resolved** · Assigned to: Orchestrator · Revision: 2

*Resolved in an earlier workspace; reopen it if the code has changed since.*

Evidence: Diagnosed by the D3 red team (D3-code-review-3): a test race, not a runtime bug. In parked_calls_are_served_abandoned_and_expired, B's WAKE loop (libs/rt/tests/parked.rs:90-92) has no exit if A's parked call already expired (LONGEST 200 ms of wall time on the fake kernel) under heavy load, so B sleeps and retries forever at ~0% CPU. The runtime behaved correctly (an expired call gets TIMED_OUT). Fix: bound B's loop (a test-only change, offered to D3-implementer-2).

### D3 implementer (2) · Question

Event: `bb3223969527c86c3143b7bd1431b56c` · 2026-09-24T21:44:51Z

> Recorded as instructed (item 5); D3 does not fix it.
> 
> What was observed: the first D3 implementer saw it while testing checkpoint 3 (b69b140f8, the libs/rt commit). With six heavy host test binaries running at once (rt, bootfsd, consoled, blkd, keyd, netd), the redoubt-rt test binary for libs/rt/tests/parked.rs stopped making progress and sat at 0% CPU until it was killed. It did not come back in six more parallel reruns or in a serial run. Its tests are parked_calls_are_served_abandoned_and_expired, parking_is_admitted_per_bucket_and_share and an_agent_flooding_a_bucket_leaves_its_sponsor_a_share_and_its_lease_end. The record doesn't say which of the three hung.
> 
> What I can add: I haven't seen it again. Hanging at 0% CPU looks like a wait with no deadline that never gets woken, not a busy spin. The server loop in that file waits with FOREVER when nothing is parked (`parked.next_deadline().map_or(FOREVER, ...)`), and its deadlines are real time (`handle::time_now()` on the fake kernel, LONGEST = 200 ms). So one guess is a wakeup that gets lost, or a deadline check that runs late, in the fake kernel when the machine is heavily loaded. That is a guess and hasn't been checked.
> 
> libs/rt/tests/parked.rs was last changed in fe807fc4b and 71ae71109. D3's rt commit only adds things (Write::Wait, mint_rooted, the panic hook, admission overrides) and doesn't touch Parked or this test. It is worth having an owner look at it (R1 or rt).
